United States Department of the Interior
OFFICE OF THE SECRETARY WASHINGTON, D.C. 20240
MAR 2 9 1972
Memorandum
To:
Assistant Secretary for Management and Budget
From:
Chief, Office of Environmental Quality
Bureau of Sport Fisheries and Wildlife
Subject:
Draft Environmental Impact Statement -- H.R. 13111
Endangered Species Legislation
In accordance with the requirements of Section 102 (2)(C) of the National Environmental Policy Act of 1969, the enclosed draft statement has been prepared for H.R. 13111. The bill provides for the conservation, protection and propagation of species or subspecies of fish and wildlife that are threatened with extinction or likely within the foreseeable future to become threatened with extinction.
Please review the statement from your particular jurisdiction or special expertise. Comments, if any, should be provided to this office within 45 days.
R. E. Jernson
Raymond E. Johnson
Enclosure
